# Service events and prompt conditions

Read from the code: every public name below, its signature and its docstring. Import `igni_extension` — defined in `igni_extension.prompt`, `igni_extension.service_events`.

| Name | What it is |
|---|---|
| [`PromptConditions`](#promptconditions) | The conditions this extension's prompt contributions wait on. |
| [`ServiceEvent`](#serviceevent) | One event from this extension's service. |

## PromptConditions

```python
class PromptConditions
PromptConditions(session: HostSession)
```

The conditions this extension's prompt contributions wait on.

### PromptConditions.holding

```python
@property
holding: dict[str, bool]
```

What was last said, by condition.

### PromptConditions.hold()

```python
async def hold(condition: str, holds: bool = True) -> None
```

Say whether one condition holds. Saying the same again sends nothing.

### PromptConditions.set()

```python
async def set(conditions: dict[str, bool]) -> None
```

Say several at once; only the ones that changed are sent.

### PromptConditions.refresh()

```python
async def refresh() -> None
```

Have igni fetch this extension's tool-sourced prompt text again.
